description: Comunidad Foral de Navarra: heat hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about heat hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Magnitud de las olas de calor. Periodo 1991-2019; Duración de las olas de calor. Periodo 1991-2019; Duración de las olas de calor. Periodo 1961-1990; Magnitud de las olas de calor. Periodo 1961-1990. Formats seen: TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
